migrations.name: 0001_domain_model
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS riders (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS drivers (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL, rating REAL, user_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vehicles (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, driver_id TEXT NOT NULL, plate TEXT NOT NULL, vehicle_class TEXT CHECK (vehicle_class IN ('share', 'comfort', 'xl')), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ride_requests (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, booking_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (booking_type IN ('now', 'scheduled', 'recurring')), status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'matched', 'paused', 'completed', 'cancelled')), pickup_label TEXT NOT NULL, pickup_lat REAL, pickup_lng REAL, dropoff_label TEXT NOT NULL, dropoff_lat REAL, dropoff_lng REAL, recurring_days TEXT, pickup_time TEXT, scheduled_for TEXT, vehicle_class TEXT CHECK (vehicle_class IN ('share', 'comfort', 'xl')), requested_at INTEGER, client_record TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ride_requests_rider_created ON ride_requests (rider_id, created_at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quotes (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, vehicle_class TEXT CHECK (vehicle_class IN ('share', 'comfort', 'xl')), fare_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, eta_minutes INTEGER, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('offered', 'accepted', 'expired')), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignments (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, driver_id TEXT NOT NULL, vehicle_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('offered', 'accepted', 'declined', 'released')), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trips (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, assignment_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived', 'completed', 'cancelled')), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trips_rider_request ON trips (rider_id, request_id); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_events (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('status')), status TEXT, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trip_events_rider_trip ON trip_events (rider_id, trip_id, at)

migrations.name: 0002_trip_history
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_transitions (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, from_status TEXT, to_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (to_status IN ('scheduled', 'en_route', 'arrived', 'completed', 'cancelled')), actor_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_type IN ('rider', 'driver', 'system')), actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, metadata TEXT, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trip_transitions_trip ON trip_transitions (rider_id, trip_id, at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trip_transitions_actor ON trip_transitions (actor_id, at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_drivers_user ON drivers (user_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_driver ON assignments (rider_id, driver_id); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trips_status_updated ON trips (rider_id, status, updated_at)

migrations.name: 0003_rider_profile
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rider_profiles (rider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, display_name TEXT, phone TEXT, notify_email INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (notify_email IN (0, 1)), notify_sms INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (notify_sms IN (0, 1)), notify_trip_updates INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (notify_trip_updates IN (0, 1)), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS saved_places (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, label TEXT NOT NULL, address TEXT NOT NULL, lat REAL, lng REAL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_saved_places_rider ON saved_places (rider_id, created_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_quotes_request ON quotes (rider_id, request_id)

migrations.name: 0004_driver_onboarding
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS driver_applications (user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'approved', 'rejected', 'suspended')), full_name TEXT, phone TEXT, licence_number TEXT, licence_region TEXT, licence_expires TEXT, eligibility_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (eligibility_confirmed IN (0, 1)), status_reason TEXT, submitted_at INTEGER, reviewed_at INTEGER, reviewed_by TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_driver_applications_status ON driver_applications (status, submitted_at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS driver_vehicles (user_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, plate TEXT NOT NULL, make TEXT NOT NULL, model TEXT NOT NULL, year INTEGER, colour TEXT, seats INTEGER, vehicle_class TEXT CHECK (vehicle_class IN ('share', 'comfort', 'xl')), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected')), status_reason TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (user_id, id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS driver_review_log (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, vehicle_id TEXT, from_status TEXT, to_status TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_role IN ('applicant', 'ops')), at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_driver_review_log_user ON driver_review_log (user_id, at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS driver_availability (user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (available IN (0, 1)), vehicle_id TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_driver_availability_available ON driver_availability (available)

migrations.name: 0005_dispatch
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS driver_locations (user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, lat REAL NOT NULL, lng REAL NOT NULL, service_radius_km REAL NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dispatch_requests (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('searching', 'matched', 'no_driver', 'cancelled')), pickup_lat REAL NOT NULL, pickup_lng REAL NOT NULL, vehicle_class TEXT, attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, started_at INTEGER NOT NULL, deadline_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, request_id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS dispatch_offers (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, driver_id TEXT NOT NULL, vehicle_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('offered', 'accepted', 'declined', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'completed')), distance_km2 REAL, offered_at INTEGER NOT NULL, expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, responded_at INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, request_id, attempt)); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_dispatch_driver_live ON dispatch_offers (driver_id) WHERE status IN ('offered', 'accepted'); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_dispatch_request_live ON dispatch_offers (rider_id, request_id) WHERE status IN ('offered', 'accepted'); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dispatch_offers_driver ON dispatch_offers (driver_id, status, expires_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dispatch_offers_expiry ON dispatch_offers (status, expires_at)

migrations.name: 0006_fare_quotes
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fare_quotes (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, pickup_label TEXT NOT NULL, pickup_lat REAL NOT NULL, pickup_lng REAL NOT NULL, dropoff_label TEXT NOT NULL, dropoff_lat REAL NOT NULL, dropoff_lng REAL NOT NULL, distance_m INTEGER NOT NULL, duration_s INTEGER NOT NULL, vehicle_class TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (vehicle_class IN ('share', 'comfort', 'xl')), base_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, distance_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, time_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, booking_fee_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, min_adjust_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, surge_milli INTEGER NOT NULL, total_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, nearby_drivers INTEGER NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'accepted', 'expired', 'superseded')), expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, accepted_at INTEGER, ride_id TEXT, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fare_quotes_rider_status ON fare_quotes (rider_id, status, expires_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fare_quotes_expiry ON fare_quotes (status, expires_at)

migrations.name: 0007_trip_lifecycle
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_lifecycle (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER, started_by TEXT, ended_at INTEGER, outcome TEXT CHECK (outcome IN ('completed', 'rider_cancelled', 'driver_cancelled', 'rider_no_show', 'driver_no_show', 'ops_cancelled')), cancelled_by_role TEXT CHECK (cancelled_by_role IN ('rider', 'driver', 'ops')), cancel_code TEXT, cancel_note TEXT, cancel_fee_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fee_policy TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, trip_id)); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, event TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event IN ('started', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'no_show', 'fee_waived', 'dispute_opened', 'dispute_resolved')), actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, actor_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor_role IN ('rider', 'driver', 'ops')), reason_code TEXT, note TEXT, amount_cents INTEGER, at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trip_lifecycle_events_trip ON trip_lifecycle_events (rider_id, trip_id, at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_disputes (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, opened_by TEXT NOT NULL, opened_role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (opened_role IN ('rider', 'driver')), reason_code TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'resolved')), opened_at INTEGER NOT NULL, decision TEXT CHECK (decision IN ('upheld', 'rejected')), resolution_note TEXT, resolved_by TEXT, resolved_at INTEGER, fee_waived INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (fee_waived IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, trip_id, opened_by)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trip_disputes_status ON trip_disputes (status, opened_at)

migrations.name: 0008_trip_locations
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS trip_locations (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, driver_id TEXT NOT NULL, lat REAL NOT NULL, lng REAL NOT NULL, accuracy_m REAL, speed_mps REAL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, trip_id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_trip_locations_updated ON trip_locations (updated_at)

migrations.name: 0009_fare_ledger
migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fare_statements (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, request_id TEXT NOT NULL, driver_user_id TEXT, receipt_no TEXT NOT NULL, basis TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (basis IN ('fare', 'cancellation_fee', 'no_show_fee', 'none')), currency TEXT NOT NULL, quote_id TEXT, quoted_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, base_cents INTEGER, distance_cents INTEGER, time_cents INTEGER, booking_fee_cents INTEGER, min_adjust_cents INTEGER, surge_milli INTEGER, final_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (final_cents >= 0), tax_rate_bp INTEGER NOT NULL, tax_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, commission_bp INTEGER NOT NULL, platform_fee_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, driver_payout_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, policy_version TEXT NOT NULL, outcome TEXT NOT NULL, pickup_label TEXT, dropoff_label TEXT, finalized_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, trip_id)); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_fare_statements_receipt ON fare_statements (receipt_no); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fare_statements_driver ON fare_statements (driver_user_id, finalized_at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fare_adjustments (rider_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, trip_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('credit', 'refund')), amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (amount_cents > 0), reason_code TEXT NOT NULL, note TEXT, actor_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (rider_id, id)); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fare_adjustments_trip ON fare_adjustments (rider_id, trip_id, created_at)
